senses.gloss:
mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Fearing, fearful.
E.
स with, भय fear.

f. (-का)
A woman whose husband is alive.
E.
स with, भर्त्तृ a husband, कन् and टाप् affs.

f. (-भा)
1 A house.
2 An assembly, a meeting.
E.
स for सह together, भा to shine, affs. अङ् and टाप्.

r. 10th cl. (सभाजयति)
1 To serve, to gratify by service.
2 To please or satisfy.
3 To see.

n. (-नं)
Courtesy, politeness, civility in receiving or taking leave of a friend.
E.
सभाज to please or gratify, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Treated with courtesy, gratified, pleased.
E.
सभाज to please, क्त aff.

m. (-तिः)
1 The keeper of a gaming house.
2 The president of an assembly.
E.
सभा an assembly, (of gamblers, &c.) and पति master.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Influencing or fascinating an assembly.
E.
सभा, and वशकर what subdues.

m. (-सत् or सद्)
One of a company, an assistant at an assembly or meeting; (in law,) an assessor.
E.
सभा an assembly, and सद् who goes.

m. (-रः)
An assistant at an assembly, one of a company.
E.
सभा an assembly, and स्तृ to cover, aff. अण्.

m. (-कः)
The keeper of a gaming house.
E.
सभा an assembly, ठक् aff; also with the penultimate vowel made long सभीक.

m. (-कः)
The keeper of a gaming house: see the last.

m. (-तः)
A Paṇḍita, a learned Brahman or teacher.
E.
सभा an assembly, and उचित fit, proper.

mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं)
1 Trusted, confidential, faithful.
2 Relating to an assembly, fit for or suitable to it.
m. (-भ्यः)
1 An assistant at an assembly.
2 An assessor.
3 A person of honourable parentage.
4 The keeper of a gaming house.
E.
सभा an assembly, &c. य aff.

m. (-मः)
A distinguished person, one who is an ornament of society.
E.
सभ्य, and तमप् affix of superl.

f. (-ता)
Politeness, refinement in manners.
E.
सभ्य, and तल् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Envious, malicious.
E.
स with, अभ्यसूया malice.
